label: GO step, just rewarded, strong commitment to a2, low value (late episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (never D1/D2), only when the reward input is 1 (previous trial rewarded) and only when the agent is about to choose a2 (model_act=2 always; policy logit strongly favors a2, choice < -8.9 holds ~90% of mass). Mostly after a rewarded a2->S2 common trial (prev_action=2 ~77% of mass, prev rare-a1 essentially never). Strongly restricted to late episode (ep_trial 60-99 holds ~95% of mass; rate 0.3% in trials 10-49) and to low value-head output, which the value cut captures. Magnitude is highest on the first reward after an unrewarded trial and decays over consecutive rewarded a2 trials (top windows: r0 then r1 a2:1.00, r1 a2:0.70). Recorded predicate uses only observed variables and the agent own policy/value; the simpler (GO & prev_reward==1 & action==2) has recall ~1.0 but precision 0.25, so it is a necessary condition. Does not fire on unrewarded trials, a1 choices, or early-episode trials.
